reasons: Classification as 'missing' is supported: the only ownership-adjacent text is a Kubient IP warranty (p0040), an AP Content/Properties warranty (p0043) and a trademark-only clause (p0065); none allocates ownership of deliverables, Requests or visitor data as between the Parties or excludes joint ownership.

The inserted General Provisions (j) reaches the preferred position with a single additive edit — Customer retains its Content/Properties/data, Vendor keeps its Service, Auction Platform and pre-existing tools, deliverables are assigned with a perpetual royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP, and joint ownership is excluded — and no existing paragraph text is disturbed.
No assignment of Customer IP or data to Kubient is created; the edit is directionally correct for the customer side and does not duplicate another rule's commercial term.
Comment is accurate, concise, uses the required prefix and first person plural, and correctly states what was added and why.

Minor, non-blocking points: the new clause says 'provide the Services' while the Agreement uses 'Service' (singular), and the Customer Data use-limitation sentence goes slightly beyond pure ownership; also the p0040 warranty covering 'products delivered hereunder' sits in mild tension with the new deliverables assignment and could be conformed.
